senses.gloss:
जैन जैन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जिन), relating to
the Jinas; (अस्), m. a Jaina, a teacher of heterodox
notions, the chief of which are the supremacy of
certain Jinas or great saints over the gods of the
Hindūs, a denial of the divine authority of the Vedas,
and a disregard of the distinction of castes; N. of a
prince of Kaśmīra.
—जैन-तरङ्गिणी, f. a history
of Kaśmīra by Śrīvara.
—जैनाश्रम (˚न-आश्˚),
अस्, m. a Jaina monastery.
—जैनेन्द्र (˚न-इन्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a grammarian.
जैन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the Jainas (?).
